entities.text: High Court Of Orissa At Cuttack
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
The present petition seeks a mandamus to be issued to the Opposite Parties- Odisha Industrial Infrastructure Development Corporation (OIIDC) and its Land Officer (Opposite Party Nos. 1 and 2 respectively) not to carry out any permanent type of constructions over Plot Nos. 486 to 489, 492 &
496 of Village haripur in Mouza Haripur, P.S. Chandaka No.21, Tahasil- Bhubaneswar without resorting to the due process of law.
2. While notice was issued in the present petition on 8th June 2016, the Court directed that status quo would be maintained by the parties.
That interim order has continued till date.

3. In response to the notice issued in the present petition, a counter affidavit has been filed on behalf of the Opposite Parties inter alia stating that the land measuring Ac.199.660 in village Haridamada & Haripur under Bhubaneswar Tahasil has been 'sanctioned in favour of IDCO during the year 2009 for establishment of Bio-Tech IT Park'.

As far as the land mentioned in the petition is concerned, the counter affidavit mentioned the steps taken for acquisition of land in question states at para-26 as under:

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
That, as regards the last course of action by IDCO, if negotiation fails, and the Petitioner is unwilling to sell the land to IDCO, in such a case IDCO will file land acquisition proposal of the said plot with the Collector as per provision of new L.A.
Act i.e. RFCTLAR & R Act, 2013."

4. Again in para-28, it is stated as under:
"28.

That, in reply to the averments made in Para-13 and 14 of the writ petition, it is pertinent to submit that in the meantime, Govt. in Revenue & Disaster Management Deptt., Odisha in their letter No.10241 dated 31.03.2014 has formulated policy/guidelines for direct purchase of the private land from the bonafide land owners.

Market value of the land shall be assessed as per provisions of Section 26 to 30 of Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation & Resettlement Act, 2013."
5.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation & Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
In view of the above statement, it is directed that without resorting to the due process of law i.e.
either by private purchase or by acquisition proceedings under the RFCTLAR & R Act, 2013, the land under occupation and ownership of the Petitioners would not be interfered with by the Opposite Parties.

It is made clear that the above order will apply only vis--vis the land actually under the occupation of as well as ownership of the Petitioners for which the Petitioners are able to establish their right, title and interest.
6. The writ petition is disposed of in the above terms.
